class.name: BulletPatterns2D
class.brief_description: The pattern library: static generators, preview tracks and layout helpers for bullet patterns.
class.description:
Static-only class (it cannot be instantiated) holding every bullet pattern of the plugin. [BulletSpawner2D] builds its volleys and its editor preview with exactly these functions, so a pattern you script here matches what a spawner with the same knobs fires.
[b]Generators[/b] ([code]helper_generate_transforms_*[/code]) return exactly the requested amount of global [Transform2D]s around a marker transform: feed them to [method BulletFactory2D.spawn_volley] through [member BulletVolleyData2D.transforms]. They are pure functions of their arguments (random layouts take a seed; 0 means a fresh roll every call), and every bad input fails loud once with an exact error and returns an empty array.
[b]Preview tracks[/b] ([code]helper_sample_outline_*[/code]) return the curve the bullets of that shape sit on, as a Dictionary with [code]points[/code] (a [PackedVector2Array]; INF points split strips) and [code]closed[/code]. Draw them to show a pattern before it fires.
[b]Layout helpers[/b]: the shared outline layout (on outline, layers, fill inside), layer scaling, side spreads, skip indices and the polyline layout used by the spawner's Path2D mode.
[method get_shapes] lists every pattern source of [member BulletSpawner2D.pattern_source] with its capabilities, for tools and pattern pickers.

method.name: debug_describe_outline
method.description: Marker-local outline report for one closed shape (see DebugOutlineShape ids): rebuilds the exact slot loop the volley generators use and returns points, facings, edge_ids, corner_flags, corner_index, edge_histogram, corners, gaps, facing deviations and a settings echo. Pure math, no scene tree needed. params carries shape knobs (size, radius, vertices, ...) plus outline_distribution, outline_corner_priority, outline_corner_mode, outline_edge_margin, outline_corner_facing; missing keys fall back to helper defaults.

method.name: debug_outline_quotas
method.description: Per-edge dot quotas plus an optimality verdict against the length-proportional largest-remainder optimum (every edge within < 1 slot of its exact share). Returns edge_counts, geometric interiors, exact_shares, optimal, worst_pair_spread (opposite-edge equality on even corner counts) and the settings echo. Corner-anchored polygonal shapes only.

method.name: debug_verify_volley
method.description: Regenerates the expected marker-local loop via debug_describe_outline and compares every single-ring (ON_OUTLINE) volley slot: origins within tolerance_px after the marker transform, facings within tolerance_rad. Returns checked count, worst deviations and the first bad index (ok stays false with an error string when sizes disagree).

method.name: debug_volley_gaps
method.description: Shape-agnostic gap metrics over an emitted transform array: consecutive origin distances in volley order plus the last-to-first closure (count, gaps, min/max/mean_gap, gap_ratio). Pass one ring's transforms to audit a single ring.

method.name: generate
method.description: Generates any pattern source without a spawner. [param shape] is a [member BulletSpawner2D.pattern_source] id (see [method get_shapes]); [param amount] is the bullet count ([member BulletSpawner2D.helper_bullets_amount], 1 to [method get_max_bullets_per_pattern]); [param marker_transform] plays the spawner's generator. [param params] names knobs exactly like the spawner properties, with or without the [code]helper_[/code] prefix ([code]{"ring_radius": 80, "outline_placement": 1}[/code]). Every value is checked with the spawner's own rule: a refused value pushes [code]BulletPatterns2D.generate: <knob> ..., keeping the old value.[/code] and the default stays. Unknown params fail loud with a did-you-mean while the others still apply. The scene inputs a spawner reads from the tree come in as params: [code]aim_position[/code] (global [Vector2], required by Aimed, optional for Corridor), [code]path_points[/code] ([PackedVector2Array] in marker space, at least 2 points, required by Path2D; recentered like a spawner in Follow Generator space) and [code]children[/code] (an [Array] of global [Transform2D] for From Children; none means the marker itself). Returns the raw pattern a spawner with the same knobs, whose generator sits at [param marker_transform], fires before its pose (spin, [member BulletSpawner2D.pattern_scale], [member BulletSpawner2D.transforms_scale] and the muzzle offset are spawner settings), with [code]skip_indices[/code] applied. Feed it to [member BulletVolleyData2D.transforms] and [method BulletFactory2D.spawn_volley].

method.name: get_max_bullets_per_pattern
method.description: Returns the per-call bullet limit (default 100000). See [method set_max_bullets_per_pattern].

method.name: get_shapes
method.description: Returns the shape registry in inspector order: one [Dictionary] per [member BulletSpawner2D.pattern_source] value, with - [code]id[/code]: the serialized pattern_source value, - [code]name[/code]: the inspector label, - [code]knob_prefix[/code]: the [code]helper_*[/code] prefix of the spawner properties this shape owns (empty for From Children and From Self), - [code]outline[/code]: a closed loop, so the shared outline layout and layers apply, - [code]corners[/code]: a corner-anchored polygon, so the corner knobs apply, - [code]reads_external_state[/code]: it reads nodes or user arrays, so the spawner never caches its pattern. The spawner's inspector gating, name lookup and pattern cache all read this same table.

method.name: helper_apply_side_spread
method.description: Side pass for closed-outline patterns: returns a copy of transforms with each origin pushed along its own facing by spread * pow(rand, spread_exponent). [param side_mode] 0 returns an identity copy, 1 pushes outward (+facing), 2 pushes inward (-facing), 3 picks a random side per bullet. Facings never change. [param seed] 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise reproducible. Only meaningful for closed loops (Ring, Ellipse, Polygon, Star, Flower, Rose, Lissajous, Custom, and the shape generators above) — open layouts have no inside to push toward.

method.name: helper_apply_skip_indices
method.description: Drops slot indexes from a generated array (dodge doors, bullet text). Out-of-range entries are ignored with one warning; the output shrinks. The spawner applies this automatically via helper_skip_indices.

method.name: helper_bullet_layer_index
method.description: Which concentric layer bullet [code]bullet_index[/code] rides (0 = the base outline). Interleaved deals round-robin ([code]i % count[/code], winding survives); Sequential fills contiguous chunks from [code]layer_start_offset[/code] (wrapping), so small volleys still read as the base shape; Outer First fills from the outermost ring inward; Ping Pong waves 0..last..0 ([code]layer_start_offset[/code] is ignored there). Degenerate inputs yield 0.

method.name: helper_compute_edge_normals
method.description: Computes one outward normal per point of a polyline, from the local tangent (averaged at joints). Use it to preview which way [method helper_generate_transforms_edge_from_points] bullets will face. A left-to-right line returns up normals ([code]Vector2(0, -1)[/code] in Godot 2D); set [param flip] to negate them. Set [param closed] for loops so the last point joins the first. Returns an empty array and logs an error when [param edge_points] is empty or not finite.

method.name: helper_extract_edge_from_image
method.description: Extracts the outline of a sprite as edge points plus normals. Opaque pixels (alpha at or above [param threshold]) that touch a transparent neighbor are sampled every [param step] pixels. Returns a [Dictionary] with [code]points[/code] (centered so the texture center is the local origin, ready for [method helper_generate_transforms_edge_from_points]) and [code]normals[/code] (pointing outward, toward transparency). Set [param quiet] to true to silence errors during editor previews. Images larger than 2048x2048 are rejected to avoid stalls. [codeblock]var edge = BulletFactory2D.helper_extract_edge_from_image(my_texture.get_image()) var volley = BulletFactory2D.helper_generate_transforms_edge_from_points(60, marker.global_transform, edge["points"])[/codeblock]

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_aimed
method.description: Generates a fan of transforms aimed from the marker at [code]target_position[/code]. Same as [method helper_generate_transforms_fan] with the cone centered on the marker to target direction. Useful for aimed bursts and shotgun spreads that track a player. Returns an empty array if the target coincides with the marker.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_circle
method.description: Generates an exact circle outline: slots spread evenly around a radius loop centered on the marker, facing outward (or inward). The outline_* tail params place slots on the loop, fill its interior, or layer it across scaled repeats about the loop center.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_corridor
method.description: Generates a wall perpendicular to aim_direction with a center dodge door of gap_width pixels: exactly transforms_amount slots, split over the two wall segments (outer edge to door edge). spacing is reserved (unused) but must still be finite and above zero; gap_width must be narrower than width, or the call returns empty. Combine with skip indices for multi-door variants. Used by the aimed trap preset.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_counter_spiral
method.description: Generates a twin counter-rotating galaxy: odd arms wind -angle_step while even arms wind +angle_step when mirrored (same facing switch as the multi spiral, including tangent-aware chirality). Turn mirroring off for a same-chirality multi spiral. Used by the twin spiral counter preset.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_cross
method.description: Generates a cross/plus barrage: arm_count rays of evenly spaced slots from the marker out to arm_length. When an arm cannot hold its slots at spacing, the spacing shrinks so the outermost slot sits on the tip (every slot keeps its own spot). Crossfire and plus-shaped danmaku bursts.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_diamond
method.description: Diamond (rhombus) perimeter from its diagonals, slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Zero-area diamonds stack at the marker.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_edge_from_points
method.description: Spawns bullets along a polyline edge (local to [param marker_transform]), each facing along the edge normal. Even sampling spreads slots uniformly by arc length (open lines include both endpoints); set [param random_sample] to pick random arc positions instead. Set [param closed] for loops and [param flip_normals] to face the other side. [param seed] 0 is non-deterministic, any other value reproduces the same volley. [param jitter] scatters origins in a disc of that radius, [param tangent_jitter] scatters them along the edge, and [param spread] adds a normal-direction cloud with [param spread_exponent] falloff on [param spread_side] (0 = along, 1 = behind, 2 = random side per bullet). Build [param edge_points] from a sprite with [method helper_extract_edge_from_image], or preview facings with [method helper_compute_edge_normals].

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_ellipse
method.description: Generates a true ellipse ring with independent [code]radius_x[/code] / [code]radius_y[/code] semi-axes rotated by [code]ellipse_rotation[/code]. Full draws every slot, Arc draws a spaced segment, Wall draws an arc with [code]gap_count[/code] dodge gaps of [code]gap_width[/code] radians each: exactly transforms_amount slots shared by the solid stretches. An Arc or Wall spanning a full turn closes like Full (no doubled seam slot). Facings follow the true outward normal of the rotated ellipse. Useful for oval bosses, stadium arenas and gap walls.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_fan
method.description: Generates a fan of transforms spread evenly across a cone. [code]direction_angle[/code] is the cone center relative to the marker rotation, [code]spread[/code] is the full cone width in radians, and [code]step_offset[/code] staggers origins along the direction so pellets do not stack on top of each other. A single bullet flies straight down the cone center. Set [code]centered[/code] to false for a one-sided fan opening from the center direction toward +spread. [code]angle_jitter[/code] adds per-slot random variance in radians for shotgun spreads (0 fires the exact cone). [code]seed[/code] drives the jitter (0 is non-deterministic). Useful for shotgun spreads.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_flower
method.description: Generates a floral spell-card pattern. In FAN mode, [code]transforms_amount[/code] slots are split evenly over [code]petals[/code] symmetric lobes (remainder spread symmetrically) and fan across [code]petal_spread[/code] radians, every slot on its own spot. [code]petal_sharpness[/code] 0 gives round lobes, higher values pinch the waist into tighter flowers. [code]flower_type[/code] picks the bloom kind (0 FAN, 1 RHODONEA, 2 PHYLLOTAXIS, 3 SPIROGRAPH, 4 SUPERFORMULA); [code]inner_radius_scale[/code], [code]spiro_roller[/code]/[code]spiro_pen[/code] and [code]super_lobes[/code]/[code]super_fullness[/code] tune the matching kind. Useful for boss blossoms and mandala rings.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_grid
method.description: Generates a grid of transforms that are positioned relative to the [code]marker_transform[/code]. [code]jitter[/code] scatters each origin by up to +-jitter pixels on both axes (0 disables it). [code]seed[/code] drives jitter and random rotation (0 is non-deterministic, otherwise reproducible).

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_heart
method.description: Generates a parametric heart outline (classic 16sin^3 curve) scaled by size. Boss love attacks and ending cards. The outline_* tail params place slots on the loop, fill its interior, or layer it across scaled repeats about the loop center.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_lattice
method.description: Generates a staggered honeycomb lattice for honeycomb walls and geometric curtains.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_line
method.description: Generates transforms in a straight wall along [code]direction[/code], spaced evenly by [code]spacing[/code]. [code]anchor[/code] picks where the marker sits on the row (start, center, end). Bullets face along the line when [code]face_direction[/code] is true - plus 90 degrees when [code]perpendicular[/code] is set, for strafe walls - otherwise they keep the marker rotation. Useful for walls, curtains and gates. Returns an empty array when the direction is zero.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_lissajous
method.description: Generates figure-8 / weave openings on the lissajous curve (size_x * sin(freq_x * t + phase), size_y * sin(freq_y * t)). The curve is swept exactly once: ratios sharing a factor are not retraced, and curves that fold back on themselves are spread along their open run, so no two slots share a spot. Recipe: slow spin + lissajous weave = butterfly curtain.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_multispiral
method.description: Generates a multi-arm spiral: [code]arms[/code] arms around the marker (galaxy, windmill and rose looks at low bullet counts). [code]arm_index_stride[/code] below the arm count interleaves consecutive slots across arms; from the arm count up, each arm takes runs of consecutive slots. Every slot lands on its own (arm, step) spot. Same facing modes as the single spiral. Useful for pinwheels, galaxies and rotating boss arms.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_polygon
method.description: Generates a polygon perimeter (vertices corners on a radius circle from base_rotation), slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). The outline_* tail params place slots on the loop, fill its interior, or layer it across scaled repeats about the loop center.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_polyline
method.description: Lays out [param transforms_amount] transforms along [param points] (marker-local, composed with [param marker_transform]); the spawner's Path2D pattern uses exactly this layout. With [constant POLYLINE_DISTRIBUTION_EVEN] the bullets spread evenly over the whole length ([param closed] loops never double the seam); with [constant POLYLINE_DISTRIBUTION_FIXED_SPACING] they sit [param spacing] pixels apart from [param anchor], shifted by [param start_offset], and [param overflow] decides what happens when the run is longer than the path. [param reverse] walks the path backwards. Each bullet faces along the path tangent or one of its normals ([param facing]) plus [param facing_offset_deg]. Fewer than 2 points or non-finite input fails loud and returns an empty array.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_rain
method.description: Generates a rain curtain: layered sheets of slots across a band of [code]band_width[/code] facing [code]rain_direction[/code]. Each row holds up to band_width / drop_spacing + 1 drops spread across the band; further rows step upstream by [code]drop_spacing[/code]. Random [code]jitter[/code] per slot; [code]seed[/code] drives it (0 is non-deterministic). Useful for bullet-rain phases, storm walls and descending curtains.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_rectangle
method.description: Generates a rectangle perimeter walk (counter-clockwise from top-left), slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Square = equal sides. The outline_* tail params place slots on the loop, fill its interior, or layer it across scaled repeats about the loop center.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_ring
method.description: Generates transforms placed evenly on a ring (or arc, when [code]arc[/code] is smaller than a full turn) around the marker. A full turn, or within half a slot of one, closes the ring without a doubled seam slot. Every bullet faces outward, so art drawn facing right travels away from the center. Set [code]face_outward[/code] to false for implosion patterns that fly toward the center. [code]y_scale[/code] stretches the ring into an ellipse (facing stays radial) and [code]facing_offset_degrees[/code] twists every facing. [code]seed[/code] drives random rotation (0 is non-deterministic). Useful for radial bursts and boss rings.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_rose
method.description: Generates an exact rhodonea rose bloom at r = R * cos(k * theta) with k = petals: odd k draws k petals, even k draws 2k, each traced once (no stacked slots). lobe_sharpness 1.0 is the exact rose (0 is round, higher pinches the waist). Used by the petal storm and blossom finale presets.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_scatter
method.description: Generates a biased-random burst: offsets fill the disc (or annulus, see below) with even density (not center-clumped). Use it for explosions, boss deaths and petal pops. [code]seed[/code] 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise reproducible — a seeded call returns bit-identical volleys every time. [code]inner_radius[/code] hollows the center into a ring (0 is a full disc; clamped to [code]burst_radius[/code]). [code]sector_direction[/code] centers a cone of [code]sector_arc[/code] radians for directional blasts and shotgun fans (TAU or more is a full circle; 0 or non-finite falls back to full circle). [code]facing_mode[/code] picks bullet facing: outward faces away from the marker, random faces anywhere, inward faces the marker (implosions); [code]facing_jitter[/code] twists outward/inward facings.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_spiral
method.description: Generates transforms along an expanding spiral around the marker. [code]facing_mode[/code] picks the bullet facing: tangent means each bullet flies along its travel direction on the spiral (the default), radial outward is the historical behavior, toward center faces the marker, keep marker preserves the marker rotation. [code]facing_offset_degrees[/code] twists every facing by a fixed amount. Useful for rotating emitter looks and volute patterns.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_star
method.description: Generates a true star shell: points alternating outer/inner vertices around the marker (distinct from the polygon helper's density bias). Boss star bursts and celebratory shells.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_star_polygon
method.description: Generates a star/polygon emphasis pattern: [code]vertices[/code] symmetric directions with extra density pulled toward each vertex. [code]vertex_bias[/code] 0 is an even ring, higher values sharpen the star. Useful for pentagram bosses, shuriken patterns and geometric spell cards.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_trapezoid
method.description: Isosceles trapezoid perimeter, slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). A zero top base degrades to a triangle; zero-area boxes stack at the marker.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_triangle
method.description: Triangle perimeter (equilateral circumradius, isosceles base + height apex-up, right X/Y legs recentered), slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Degenerate triangles stack at the marker.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_waterfall
method.description: Generates a staggered waterfall curtain: columns by rows grid with per-row stagger offsets and jitter, firing along rain_direction. [code]seed[/code] drives the jitter (0 is non-deterministic). Past capacity the curtain keeps growing row by row instead of stacking. Combine with skip indices for readable doors.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_wave
method.description: Generates a snake row along a sine wave of width, amplitude and wave count around the marker axis. Pairs with wobble flight for slithering curtains.

method.name: helper_layer_scale_factor
method.description: Scale factor for one outline layer (1.0 for layer 0). A non-empty [code]custom_scales[/code] list wins outright (entry [code]layer_index % size[/code]); otherwise Outward grows (linearly, or compounded per [code]scale_curve[/code]), Inward crowds toward the center reciprocally, Both alternates. Shared by the generators and the spawner preview so rings can never disagree with bullets. Warns and returns 1.0 on bad inputs.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_circle
method.description: Circle loop track in marker-local pixels (adaptive density). Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_counter_spiral
method.description: Mirrored-arm variant of the multispiral strips with INF separators (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_diamond
method.description: Diamond corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_ellipse
method.description: Ellipse sweep in marker-local pixels (adaptive density). Closed for full rings; wall mode draws its arc span in full (gaps read from the missing bullets).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_flower
method.description: Flower bloom track sampler in marker-local pixels mirroring [method helper_generate_transforms_flower] per-type math (closed loop). [code]flower_type[/code] selects the bloom kind (see [enum FlowerBloom]): FAN traces the petal arcs, RHODONEA and SPIROGRAPH and SUPERFORMULA trace their actual curve, PHYLLOTAXIS bounds the Vogel disc rim. With [code]transforms_amount[/code] 0 or more, FAN skips petals that hold no bullet (-1 draws every petal). Per-type knobs apply only to their matching bloom kind.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_grid
method.description: Grid row strips with INF separators between rows (open). Ideal structure only.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_heart
method.description: Parametric heart sweep. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_lattice
method.description: Lattice row strips with INF separators between rows (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_lissajous
method.description: Lissajous sweep in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_multispiral
method.description: One strip per arm with INF separators between arms (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_polygon
method.description: Polygon corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_rain
method.description: Rain row strips with INF separators between rows (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_rectangle
method.description: Rectangle corners in marker-local pixels, counter-clockwise from top-left. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_ring
method.description: Ring arc sweep in marker-local pixels (adaptive density). Closed for full TAU arcs.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_rose
method.description: Rose theta sweep in marker-local pixels (flips included, matching slot order). Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_spiral
method.description: Spiral arm sweep (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_star
method.description: Star corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_trapezoid
method.description: Trapezoid corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_triangle
method.description: Triangle corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_waterfall
method.description: Waterfall row strips with INF separators between rows (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_wave
method.description: Sine center-line sweep (open).

method.name: set_max_bullets_per_pattern
method.description: Sets the per-call bullet limit shared by every [code]helper_generate_transforms_*[/code] method, [method generate], [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_bullets_amount], [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_custom_transforms] and the shape counts (star points, polygon vertices, ellipse gaps; grids allow four times as many slots). It only exists so a typo like [code]1000000000[/code] fails loudly instead of freezing or exhausting memory: raise it as high as your game needs. The default is 100000 and can be changed for the whole project with the project setting [code]blastbullets2d/patterns/max_bullets_per_pattern[/code], which is applied when the plugin loads. A [param limit] below 1 pushes an error and keeps the old value. Lowering the limit never edits amounts a spawner already holds: they are refused at the next generation. Main thread only.
